'''Slow Aura''' is a [[debuff]] caused by a [[monster aura]] from various monster mods. Monster as well as players and their minions affected by the aura also have a purple-pink colour visual effect on them.

It affects only player and their minions [[movement speed]], but not [[action speed]].
==Monsters==
* Any monster with modifier [[Modifier:MonsterImplicitAuraSlow1|MonsterImplicitAuraSlow1]] (implicit), for example:
** [[Grinning Totem]]
** [[Stranglecharm]]
** [[Nadia the Soothing]] and the map variant [[Spirit of Nadia]]
** [[The Broken Prince]] ({{il|Vaal Pyramid Map}})

===Legacy===
* Any monster with prefix modifier [[Modifier:MonsterAuraSlow1|MonsterAuraSlow1]] (mod name as well as the debuff were known as "{{c|mod|Slow Aura}}", but the mod was displayed as {{c|normal|Enemies are Slowed}} under the monster nameplate).
:However, this mod is removed from the monster mod pool in version 3.18.0. Although this mod can still be found in permanent leagues' [[The Menagerie]] or itemized beast, which monsters with this mod are captured by the players before the mod's removal.
